blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — After more than a month above the critical-high mark, the water level at Laguna de Bay fell below the threshold, reaching 12.41 meters on Thursday morning, the Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA) said. The latest reading, recorded at 8:30 a.m., was 0.09 meters or nine centimeters below the 12.50-meter critical-high level, according to an LLDA advisory. “Based on the latest official monitoring of the Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA), the water level of Laguna Lake continues to show a steady downward trend,” the agency said.
